name: Geum Okran
role: Retired S-rank; tteokbokki stallholder and trainer
proportions: About six heads tall, broad wrestler shoulders and forearms, robust low planted stance; never cute or frail outside designated chibi sheet.

palette.apron: Faded red and off-white broad checks; match front.png
palette.headscarf: Faded grey-green floral cloth; match front.png

locks: Anatomical LEFT arm replaced from just above elbow, battered gunmetal plates and rivets, faded blue wave on forearm, exactly three thick fingers and one thumb.
Anatomical RIGHT hand is natural, five digits, and always carries the same long-handled steel ladle.
One gold tooth on anatomical upper LEFT, visible in grins.
Short permed grey hair under faded floral headscarf knotted at nape.
Red-and-white checked apron over faded purple tracksuit, sleeves pushed up.
Pink rubber slippers; short, broad, weathered and formidable.
reference_policy: Final front.png (attempt 2) is the first reference for every final derived sheet. Chibi additionally uses S24's own locally checked details.png for the four-digit hand construction. No outside images or rejected images were attached as references after rejection.

sheet_spec.format: Native generated PNG, copied byte-for-byte as ordinary files

expressions_order: rare soft look out to sea
review_status: Local Codex check only; awaiting Claude review

known_faults.chibi.png: Top-row third folded-arm pose has a small skin-coloured fingertip shape at the far shoulder where the metal left hand should be hidden. Best attempt 4 retained after all five tries under the 27 October override.

chibi_poses: confident gold-toothed grin, metal hand on hip
head cocked, leaning to read an off-panel body
belly laugh through a toothy grin
comic surprise at twitching metal arm
